block.title: Fourteen retired documents moved to docs/archive, at their old addresses
block.p: The Python experiment runner and its Tagflow viewer (five documents, retired for the campaign service), the September thread-cancellation design, checkpoint, notes and raw results, and four one-off campaign records now live in docs/archive/. Each still renders at the same address under docs/, marked archived with the same banner nanofil's archive uses, and the docs index lists them in one Archive section instead of beside the current guides.
Thread cancellation: what Fil-C needs to get right stays a current document; it links its archived records.
